note: caiso-153 recipe with NO FLAG CHANGE AT ALL — every ScenarioConfig field is byte-identical to the control (K3 verified). The delta is that two DERIVED-NOT-COMMITTED data/clean partitions the keeper's OWN armed flags require are PRESENT on disk again: hydro-plant-modes/CAISO (behind hydro_ror_split) and capacity-deliverability/CAISO (behind capacity_deliverability_limits). THE DEFECT IT FIXES: data/clean is gitignored and dies with the container, and both loaders were written to DEGRADE GRACEFULLY — an absent partition logs a warning and the mechanism becomes a silent no-op while the run's meta still advertises it. meta.shared_inputs pins exactly these derived inputs (bundle_io.write_derived_solve_inputs, whose own docstring calls this 'the silent-degrade trap' and records that 'an absent partition records nothing, exactly the state the solve degraded to'), and an audit of all 131 bundles on disk dates the regression between caiso-142 (2026-07-30, pinned) and caiso-146 (2026-07-31, absent): the keepers promoted at caiso-146, -147, -148, -151 AND -153 ALL solved with both mechanisms armed-but-inert. The same check on every other ISO's designated keeper is clean, so the defect is CAISO-EXCLUSIVE. THE GOVERNANCE CONSEQUENCE, which is what makes this a rule-20 [R-DOF] / rule-24 [R-REGISTRY] defect and not housekeeping: with deliverability Part A a no-op the CAISO import node falls back to the hard-coded WECC_import_simultaneous cap of 7,500 MW — a RESIDUAL-identified fitted scalar that the keeper's own DOF ledger records as 'Not in the keeper binding path' and that iso_configs.py carries expressly 'so this fallback cannot silently re-become the binding import limit'. Measured on the degraded control's own LP DUALS, that claim was FALSE: the seam group binds in 757 / 472 / 857 hours of 2023/24/25 carrying -$187.2M / -$15.1M / -$26.9M of congestion rent, with p95/p99/max import all exactly 7,500.000 MW, and 18.0 % of Sep-Dec 2025 pinned. Restoring the partition installs the PUBLISHED branch-group MIC (16,055 / 16,452 / 16,148 MW) and the seam's binding-hour count falls to 0 / 0 / 0 with rent exactly 0.000 in every year — reproducing caiso-133's measurement that the ACCURATE seam is inert in dispatch, and handing the binding limit back to the MEASURED p95 corridor envelopes (caiso_corridor_flow_limit, armed; their 2023 binding hours rise 2,850->3,360 and 3,116->3,273 as they take the constraint back). The hydro half restores the ORNL-EHA RoR classifier (69 of 171 LP plants flat at their own monthly water in 2023, 61 of 160 in 2025) and with it the min-flow floor's reconciliation onto the reservoir class alone — which cannot happen at all with the classifier absent. ZERO new free parameters, no threshold moved, no config field changed; both restored inputs are external published data (ORNL EHA FY2024 + HILARRI v4; CAISO MIC/LCR postings). A fail-fast guard shipped with it (market_sim.data.input_completeness, called at the single shared per-year solve seam) now RAISES instead of degrading, so an armed mechanism can never again run without its data. disposition_note: DETERMINATION CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, CARRIED OVER UNCHANGED from the caiso-153 keeper: the same 2 of 3 non-protective ledgered slots (C3c-2023/24 and C3a-2025, both the OWNER's act of 2026-07-30 at caiso-145), protective 0 of 1, and 0 FAILs. PROMOTED ON STRUCTURAL-INTEGRITY GROUNDS, and the price result is stated plainly rather than dressed up: THE PRICE GATE DID NOT CLOSE. C3a improves in every year but only slightly — 2023 +3.4 % -> +3.1 %, 2024 +9.3 % -> +9.2 %, 2025 +12.2 % -> +12.0 % (load-weighted lambda 38.60 -> 38.52 $/MWh against a 34.39 actual) — against the +/-10 % band, so C3a-2025 REMAINS a ledgered caveat and this session claims NO closure of it. The reason the movement is small is itself measured, not assumed: the MEASURED corridor envelopes bind almost as soon as the fitted seam is relaxed (their binding hours rise while the seam's fall to zero), so the extra deliverable import is +0.456 TWh in 2023, not the several TWh a naive 7,500->16,055 MW reading would suggest. What DID change decisively is that a residual-identified DOF the attestation declared retired is no longer on the binding path in any hour of any year. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] and rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] govern the promotion in both directions: the accurate input goes in because it is the accurate input, NOT because a residual moved — and it would equally have gone in had the residual worsened. NO gate regressed: every C3a year improves, C1/C2/C3b/C4 verdicts are unchanged, and the protective gates hold (C7 shape PASS, C8 forced share PASS, D-4 off-window binding PASS, D-2 PASS). D-1's ST_GAS FAIL rows (2024 r 0.158, 2025 r -0.049) are BIT-COMPARABLE to the control's (0.162 / -0.044) and to the committed keeper's — pre-existing, on a class the rubric skips as immaterial (0.3 % / 0.1 % of ISO load), and NOT introduced here. RULE 22 leave-one-year-out: this session fits NOTHING — zero free parameters introduced or moved, both restored inputs external published data — so LOYO reduces to the no-held-out-degradation check, which passes trivially (all three years improve, none degrades). CAISO still holds NO rule-22 calibration-complete marker, so every out-of-training year (2022, 2019, <=2021, H1-2026) stays fully quarantined; this session solved 2023/2024/2025 only and wrote no marker. THE DOF LEDGER ROW IS CORRECTED, NOT QUIETLY FIXED: WECC_import_simultaneous.cap_mw keeps its 'not in the keeper binding path' claim but now records that the claim was FALSE for caiso-146..153 with the measured binding-hour counts, and re-verifies it TRUE on this bundle from this bundle's own duals. SCOPE LIMIT, stated not engineered around: the input-completeness guard covers exactly the two mechanisms this session proves; widening it to other armed-flag/partition pairs is FILED, not absorbed, because each addition owes its own check that 'partition absent' is distinguishable from a legitimate ISO-level no-op. Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-caiso157-derived-partition-restore-2026-08-02.md.
